questions.question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, K, L and M are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.Only three boxes are kept above C.  Only one box is kept between L and C.  Only three boxes are kept between L and M. M is kept at some place above C. A is kept immediately below M. B is kept at one of the places above D. K is not kept immediately above or below L.Which box is kept at the lowermost position?

To which of the following is 33 related, following the same logic?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)56

A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B sits to the immediate right of D. C is an immediate neighbour of both F and A. E sits third to the right of A. A is an immediate neighbour of D. What is the position of F with respect to E?

Pavan starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards North. He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?(All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (3 km to the west) है।

Each of D, G, K, P, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. T has an exam on Thursday. U has an exam on one of the days after G and on one of the days before P. No one has an exam after V. Only D has an exam immediately between V and K. How many people have exams between P and V?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements: All tables are mugs.Some mugs are bats.Some bats are chocolates.Conclusions:(I) Some chocolates are tables.(II) Some bats are tables.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

questions.question: In this question, two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements maybe the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct option.A. The leader of the group ‘Citizens of Today’ asked its members to contribute ₹2,000 before January 19.B. The group ‘Citizens of Today’ need funds to conduct its annual meeting programme in the last week of January.
options: Statement A is the cause and statement B is the effect.
Statement B is the cause and statement A is the effect.
Both statements A and B are effects of a common cause.
Both statements A and B are independent causes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Statement B is the cause and statement A is the effect.) है।
